split_manifest.deployment_question: Given historical monthly snapshots whose 90-day outcomes have fully materialised by the training cutoff timestamp, how accurately can we score active accounts (including returning customers and newly onboarded accounts) in future calendar months?

findings.rule_title: Account / Group Identifier Overlap Across Partitions

observed_evidence.note: Returning active accounts across future waves are explicitly permitted by the Future-Period contract.

findings.consequence_explanation: Group partition alignment matches the declared evaluation protocol.

findings.rule_title: Exact Predictor-Vector Duplicates Across Partitions
findings.consequence_explanation: Zero exact predictor-vector duplicates cross partition boundaries.

findings.rule_title: Near-Duplicate Records Crossing Partitions (Bounded L2 Check)
findings.consequence_explanation: No unexplained near-duplicate records detected within bounded L2 check.

findings.rule_title: Target or Target-Derived Features Included in Predictors
findings.consequence_explanation: No target or target-derived columns detected in predictors.

findings.rule_title: Feature Availability at Prediction Timestamp (Point-in-Time Audit)
findings.consequence_explanation: All registered predictors have availability_lag_hours <= 0.0.

findings.rule_title: Temporal Ordering and 90-Day Outcome-Window Purge Verification
findings.consequence_explanation: Chronological ordering and 90-day outcome-window purging are strictly satisfied.

findings.rule_title: Preprocessing Fit Boundary Provenance Check
findings.consequence_explanation: FitProvenanceRecord confirms 100% of fitted row hashes belong exclusively to the training partition (and training sub-folds during cross-validation).

findings.rule_title: Resampling / Class Balancing Boundary Check
findings.consequence_explanation: Resampling boundary is strictly isolated to training data.

findings.rule_title: Identifiers, Timestamps or Lineage Metadata in Predictors
findings.consequence_explanation: All identifiers, timestamps and lineage fields are excluded from predictors.

findings.rule_title: Label Consistency, Right-Censoring & Data-Quality Check
findings.consequence_explanation: Zero right-censored outcomes or conflicting (account_id, observation_date) labels in active splits.

findings.rule_title: Covariate and Target Prevalence Shift Across Partitions

observed_evidence.classification_note: Classified as DISTRIBUTION_SHIFT, NOT data leakage. Shift across temporal waves or cohorts requires calibration monitoring and slice evaluation.

findings.consequence_explanation: Covariate or base-rate drift between training and test periods can degrade probability calibration and shift precision/recall trade-offs at a fixed threshold.
findings.recommended_correction: Inspect cohort-level calibration and evaluate whether recalibration or threshold adjustment on recent development windows is warranted.

controlled_fixtures_summary.provenance_dependency_analysis: FIX-01 (Account Overlap), FIX-03 (Cross-Split Duplicates) and FIX-05 (Pre-Split Minority Oversampling via duplicate hashes) are detectable directly from partitioned CSV rows. In contrast, FIX-02 (Future Feature Availability) and FIX-04 (Pre-Split Imputation/Scaling) require FeatureSpec lag metadata and FitProvenanceRecord row-hash logs to confirm definitively; in Raw-CSV mode they are appropriately reported as SUSPICIOUS_SIGNAL or UNVERIFIABLE_MISSING_PROVENANCE.

fixtures.name: Repeated-Account Contamination via Row-Level Split
fixtures.injected_fault_description: Partitioned longitudinal snapshots using a random row-level train_test_split instead of grouping by account_id under the New-Account Generalisation protocol.

findings.rule_title: Account / Group Identifier Overlap Across Partitions
findings.consequence_explanation: Under the New-Account Generalisation protocol (allow_returning_accounts=False), repeated snapshots of the same customer appear in both training and evaluation. Models can exploit persistent account-specific baselines, inflating new-account metrics.
findings.recommended_correction: Partition using StratifiedGroupKFold or GroupShuffleSplit keyed on 'account_id' so all snapshots of an account reside in a single partition.

contaminated_vs_corrected_metrics.interpretation: Random row-level splitting allows persistent account random effects to appear in both Train and Test, modestly inflating apparent New-Account Generalisation scores compared with strict account-group isolation.

fixtures.name: Future Target-Derived Feature (Post-Observation Retention Credits)
fixtures.injected_fault_description: Added predictor 'retention_credits_issued_next_60d' which is finalised +60 days after observation_date and is noisy-derived from the future 90d churn trajectory.

findings.rule_title: Target or Target-Derived Features Included in Predictors

observed_evidence.provenance_source: Lineage registry confirms post-observation target derivation.

findings.consequence_explanation: A feature directly encoding or derived from the future churn outcome is present in the predictor matrix, invalidating offline evaluation and causing catastrophic failure at deployment when future outcomes are unknown.
findings.recommended_correction: Remove ['retention_credits_issued_next_60d'] from feature_columns immediately and enforce contract predictor allow-listing.

findings.rule_title: Feature Availability at Prediction Timestamp (Point-in-Time Audit)
findings.consequence_explanation: Predictors have availability_lag_hours > 0 relative to observation_date, meaning their values are finalised after prediction time (look-ahead leakage).
findings.recommended_correction: Exclude ['retention_credits_issued_next_60d'] or lag their aggregation window so all inputs close on or before observation_date.

findings.rule_title: Covariate and Target Prevalence Shift Across Partitions

observed_evidence.classification_note: Classified as DISTRIBUTION_SHIFT, NOT data leakage. Shift across temporal waves or cohorts requires calibration monitoring and slice evaluation.

findings.consequence_explanation: Covariate or base-rate drift between training and test periods can degrade probability calibration and shift precision/recall trade-offs at a fixed threshold.
findings.recommended_correction: Inspect cohort-level calibration and evaluate whether recalibration or threshold adjustment on recent development windows is warranted.

contaminated_vs_corrected_metrics.interpretation: Including a post-observation retention credit feature artificially inflates PR-AUC and ROC-AUC above 0.95. In Full-Provenance mode, LAK-004 and LAK-005 confirm leakage; in Raw-CSV mode without feature lag metadata, the detector flags it as a SUSPICIOUS_SIGNAL requiring provenance verification.

fixtures.name: Exact and Near-Duplicate Records Crossing Partitions
fixtures.injected_fault_description: Copied 75 exact training snapshots and 45 slightly jittered training snapshots (0.5% Gaussian noise on numericals) into the test partition.

findings.rule_title: Exact Predictor-Vector Duplicates Across Partitions
findings.consequence_explanation: Identical predictor vectors appear in both training and evaluation splits. High-capacity models can memorise exact training records, artificially distorting validation and test metrics.
findings.recommended_correction: Deduplicate snapshots prior to partitioning and ensure resampling or data augmentation never occurs before Train/Val/Test splitting.

findings.rule_title: Near-Duplicate Records Crossing Partitions (Bounded L2 Check)
findings.consequence_explanation: Test records exist within an extremely small standardised Euclidean radius of training records. This may indicate jittered duplicate injection, synthetic oversampling before splitting or near-identical snapshot cloning.
findings.recommended_correction: Inspect flagged near-duplicate pairs to determine whether they represent legitimate stable accounts across time or contaminated jittered copies.

findings.rule_title: Covariate and Target Prevalence Shift Across Partitions

observed_evidence.classification_note: Classified as DISTRIBUTION_SHIFT, NOT data leakage. Shift across temporal waves or cohorts requires calibration monitoring and slice evaluation.

findings.consequence_explanation: Covariate or base-rate drift between training and test periods can degrade probability calibration and shift precision/recall trade-offs at a fixed threshold.
findings.recommended_correction: Inspect cohort-level calibration and evaluate whether recalibration or threshold adjustment on recent development windows is warranted.
